name: Julius Quignard
original_name: ユリウス・キニャール
source:
Argo's upperclassman who has a strong interest in other cultures. He has a boisterous personality and tends to show off, but he is highly regarded by the professors for his "cheating" ability.

Likes: Foreign countries, travel, swords, food.
Dislikes: Boredom.

[Taken from [url=http://kaiju09.com/knights_college/english/]official character profile[/url].]
